scope: Proposition 6.2 of the manuscript “Generalized ionization energies for full Coulomb atoms” (preprints/Generalized-ionization-energies-for-full-Coulomb-atoms-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 263 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1450c11be0743629), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: With the two-spin coefficient T fixed above, lim Z→∞ [ ETF Z (Z − 1) − ETF Z (Z) ] = 3 7 q−4/3 . (6.7) The limit holds through real charges Z > 1. Consequently Equation (1.2) holds for every fixed real m > 0, with aTF = 3 7 q−4/3 > 0.
